purpose: Small canonical support layer for concepts referenced directly by the permanent tree but not yet promoted into the main node registry.

records.name: Life
records.description: The atlas-wide concept of living continuity: biology, growth, care, relationship, renewal and the capacity of systems to sustain what depends on them.

records.name: Growth
records.description: Increase or development through time, including biological growth, learning, institutional development, productive capacity and the maturation of relationships.
